messages:
Nora H: Quick alert to @eng-security — during a telemetry ingest run into analytics-sandbox someone inadvertently rsynced a directory that contained plaintext CI runner Personal Access Tokens (PATs) into a temporary GCS bucket. Bucket was internal-only and not public, but tokens are still valid. We need immediate revocation and short-term mitigations.

sec-bot: Automated scanner detected 4 candidate tokens in gs://analytics-temp/2026-03-23/ and created ticket SEC-7234. Scanned for external access logs: none. Notifying token owners via DM.

Nora H: TL;DR: rotate/revoke PATs, replace with OIDC where possible, rotate any CI secrets that used the PATs, update deployment keys, and confirm in-thread by EOW PT. Platform team will block egress for the bucket briefly.

Liang W: Which CI systems? Are we talking GitHub Actions runners or internal runners? Any pipeline downtime?

Nora H: Primary impact is GitHub Actions runner credentials used by team-experiments and model-sync jobs. A couple of internal ephemeral runners used the same PAT for repo clones. No immediate production pipelines appear affected.

Sasha M: Recommended quick commands for GitHub PAT rotation:

```
# list PATs to revoke (replace with internal mapping)
gh auth status --show-token --hostname github.com
# create new tokens via web UI or gh CLI org flow, then update vault
gh auth refresh -h github.com --scopes repo,workflow
vault kv put secret/ci/github/team-experiments token=@new_token.txt
```

Sasha M: For internal runners switch to OIDC where possible: set up workload identity and update runners to use short-lived tokens. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/ci/oidc-migration

platform-ops: We'll apply a temporary bucket policy denying any inbound service account reads except from the ingest job service account. That will minimize blast radius while you rotate. We'll also snapshot the bucket and then restrict lifecycle.

security-oncall: Checklist: 1) revoke exposed PATs on GitHub 2) rotate any Vault entries that referenced them 3) rotate deploy keys and update runner configs 4) run `secret-scan --path gs://analytics-temp` and attach report 5) confirm with timestamped evidence (screenshot or vault read showing new secret id). If you cannot rotate immediately, disable the token and require token creation via web UI with MFA.

Liang W: I've revoked two tokens for model-sync and rotated Vault entries. Updated runner config to use a new token stored at secret/ci/github/model-sync. Will kick a test run.

Nora H: Thanks. Sasha, can you help teams migrate to OIDC by end of Q2? We should make OIDC the default for runners and deprecate long-lived PATs.

Sasha M: Yep — I'll schedule 1:1 migration sessions and draft a rollout plan. Also proposing an org-wide policy change: disallow long-lived PATs for CI in favor of OIDC or short-lived app tokens.

platform-ops: Bucket ACLs tightened and egress blocked for analytics-temp. No external access observed. No customer impact.

security-oncall: Confirming sec-bot ticket SEC-7234 updated with revocation timestamps and attachments. Closing alert after all teams confirm. If you find any repos that used the PATs indirectly, escalate to this thread.

Liang W: Confirmed rotation and successful test run. :white_check_mark:

Nora H: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up with a short advisory to the org outlining the new policy and migration timeline. If any team needs hands-on help, ping @Sasha M or @platform-ops.
